title: Lower bound for fibres of an irreducible finite-type scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be an irreducible scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Put $Z=\overline{f(X)}$ with the topological closure in $Y$ and put $r=\dim X-\dim Z$, where dimensions are topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For every $x\in X$, the local topological dimension of the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_{f(x)}=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(f(x))$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] at the point corresponding to $x$ is at least $r$. Moreover, the locus of points where this local fibre dimension equals $r$ is dense open in $X$.
